title: Gap between Automation Buttons too big on small phone
symptom: The automation buttons are too big on a small phone (e.g. Cubot KingKong Mini3), with too much space between buttons and lost space within each button, causing text to be cropped.
fix: Improved the layout by reducing padding within each button and adding icons for each action, as implemented in commit 3751ef73ce017691aa434a46e53175c194dd3688 and further refined in 56aaf854.
